newsitem.title: USA: Procyte says gets FDA ok to market dressing.
newsitem.headline: Procyte says gets FDA ok to market dressing.

text.p: ProCyte Corp said on Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved the company's OsmoCyte Pillow Wound Dressing for marketing.
The OsmoCyte Pillow is used in the care of chronic and acute wounds. It cushions the wound and absorbs excess moisture over a longer period of time than standard dressings.
Clinical studies have shown that the pillow dressing is effective in the care of diabetic ulcers, pressure sores, and venous stasis ulcers, the company said in a statement.
Industry reports estimate the annual cost of wound care may range from $1.9 to $2.5 billion in the U.S., ProCyte said.
